channel.description: Find the right tool at the right price.

item.title: Kobalt 80V Leaf Blower Kit with Two Batteries for $209
item.description: The Kobalt 80-volt handheld leaf blower delivers 630 CFM and 140 MPH. This kit includes a 2.5 Ah battery and charger, plus a free second 2.5 Ah battery. The price is $209, with free in-store pickup or possibly free delivery.

item.title: efrozen 0.095-inch trimmer line spool, 295 feet, drops to $10.44
item.description: This is a 295-foot spool of 0.095-inch heavy-duty nylon trimmer line, designed as a universal replacement for most weed wackers. The price is $10.44 with free delivery from Amazon, sold by the manufacturer.

item.title: Fiskars Ergo Garden Hand Weeder for $7.15 at Home Depot
item.description: The Fiskars Ergo Garden Hand Weeder is a heavy-duty tool designed for removing weeds and roots with minimal effort. This deal offers the tool at $7.15 with free delivery from Home Depot.

item.title: Shark NeverChange Air Purifier Bundle with CleanSense IQ for $119.99
item.description: The Shark NeverChange Air Purifier Bundle includes the HP152B2 model with CleanSense IQ technology that displays real-time air quality adjustments. It exceeds HEPA standards with Anti-Allergen features. The bundle is available for $119.99 with free shipping.

item.title: Expert Grill Refillable Grill Lighter for $1 at Walmart
item.description: Walmart is offering the Expert Grill Refillable Grill Lighter for $1, with a 5-pack available for $4.85. The deal includes free store pickup, and shipping is free for Walmart+ members or orders over $35.

item.title: Craftsman 1/4-inch Nut Driver Drops to $8.92
item.description: The Craftsman CMHT65078 is a magnetic 1/4-inch nut driver, now available for $8.92. This price is the lowest seen in at least 365 days, making it a solid deal for a hand tool.

item.title: CRAFTSMAN 26-Piece Ratcheting Screwdriver Set for $15.99
item.description: This CRAFTSMAN multibit ratcheting screwdriver set includes 26 pieces and features speed and precision tactile zones for quick rotation control, along with a torque zone for added grip. The deal offers the set at $15.99.

item.title: CRAFTSMAN 12-Inch Hacksaw for $9.99
item.description: This CRAFTSMAN hacksaw features a 12-inch blade for cutting metal and plastic. The deal price is $9.99, with free shipping for Amazon Prime members.

item.title: HOMPER Stainless Steel Grill Baskets 2-Pack for $9.99
item.description: This 2-pack of HOMPER nesting rolling BBQ grill baskets is made from 304 stainless steel and includes removable wooden handles. The set is priced at $9.99 with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: CRAFTSMAN 25-Ft Tape Measure with Fraction Markings for $12.98
item.description: This CRAFTSMAN tape measure features a 25-foot blade with fraction markings and a manual-locking mechanism. It offers a 13-foot reach for easy solo measurements and a compact size for convenient storage. The deal price is $12.98.

item.title: Royal Gourmet Barrel Charcoal Grill with Side Shelves and Hanging Basket for $134.99
item.description: This Royal Gourmet barrel charcoal grill includes side shelves and a hanging basket, suitable for backyard gatherings and picnics. The grill is available for $134.99 with free delivery from Home Depot.

item.title: Worx 20V String Trimmer with 2 Batteries Drops to $84.99 at Amazon
item.description: The Worx 20V GT 3.0 Cordless PowerShare String Trimmer includes two batteries and offers a 12-inch cutting width. Amazon is selling this trimmer for $84.99 with free shipping, a reduction from a previous frontpage price of $94.

item.title: Alpulon 2-in-1 Portable Gas Grill in Red for $151.20
item.description: This portable natural gas grill from Alpulon features a 2-in-1 design with four detachable legs, making it easy to transport and set up. The grill is available in red and is currently priced at $151.20 with free delivery from Home Depot.

item.title: FIROMO 4-Burner Gas Grill with Side Burner Now $227.99 at Home Depot
item.description: This FIROMO 4-burner propane gas grill features a stainless steel construction, a side burner, condiment rack, and built-in thermometer. It is currently available for $227.99 with free delivery from Home Depot.

item.title: Royal Gourmet 4-Burner Grill Griddle Combo with Hood for $239.99
item.description: This Royal Gourmet combo unit features four burners delivering 40,000 BTU, with a grill and griddle surface plus a hood. It is available for $239.99 with free delivery from Home Depot.

item.title: Royal Gourmet 6-Burner Gas Grill with Side Burner and Infrared Rear Burner, $679.99 at Home Depot
item.description: This Royal Gourmet Deluxe gas grill features six stainless steel burners, a side burner, an infrared rear burner, LED control knobs, and a glass view window. The grill is available for $679.99 with free delivery from Home Depot.

item.title: Royal Gourmet 6-Burner Gas Grill with Sear and Side Burner, $399.99 at Home Depot
item.description: This Royal Gourmet gas grill features six burners, a sear burner, and a side burner, delivering 71,000 BTU of cooking power. The cabinet-style design includes a cover, and the grill is available for $399.99 with free delivery from Home Depot.

item.title: Charcoal grill with side shelves now $117.99 with free shipping
item.description: This charcoal grill from Charbroil includes side shelves for extra workspace. The grill is currently available for $117.99 with free shipping.

item.title: Four-Burner Stainless Steel BBQ Grill for $261.73 with Free Shipping
item.description: This stainless steel four-burner commercial BBQ grill delivers 32,000 BTUs of cooking power. The deal price is $261.73 with free shipping.

item.title: Ozark Trail 15" Smokeless Fire Pit with Carry Bag, $99.48 at Walmart
item.description: The Ozark Trail 15-inch stainless steel fire pit features a collapsible design for easy transport and storage, and it burns wood with reduced smoke. Walmart offers it for $99.48 with free shipping.

item.title: Heat-Resistant BBQ Gloves for $7.99 at Amazon
item.description: These silicone grilling gloves from Comsmart offer heat resistance up to 1472 degrees Fahrenheit, with a non-slip grip for safe handling of hot items. They are suitable for barbecue, cooking, baking, and oven use. The deal price is $7.99, shipped from Amazon.

item.title: Kaluns 35-Piece BBQ Grill Tools Set with Case, Thermometer, Injector, Claws & Mats for $29.99
item.description: This 35-piece BBQ grill tools set includes a meat thermometer, injector, claws, and mats, all housed in a carrying case. The set is priced at $29.99 after clipping a $5 off coupon, sold by CFNY and shipped from Amazon.

item.title: Greenworks 80V String Trimmer with Battery and Charger, $199.99 at Costco
item.description: This Greenworks 80V Gen 3 string trimmer features a 17-inch cutting path and a brushless motor, offering gas-like power without the emissions. The deal includes a 2.0Ah battery and charger, with a manufacturer's savings of $60 off the regular price, valid through August 31, 2026.

item.title: Greenworks 80V 21" Self-Propelled Mower with Batteries for $323
item.description: This is a renewed Greenworks 80V 21-inch cordless 4-in-1 self-propelled lawn mower. It comes with a 4.0 Ah battery, a 2.0 Ah battery, and a rapid charger. Use coupon code SDNEWSLETTER15 to get the price of $323 with free shipping.

item.title: Klein Tools 14-in-1 Screwdriver on Clearance at Lowe's
item.description: This Klein Tools 14-in-1 multi-bit screwdriver features an adjustable length design for versatile use. It is on clearance at Lowe's for $5.72, available for local pickup only.

item.title: Nordic Ware Kettle Smoker with Woodchips Drops to $19.97 at Costco
item.description: The Nordic Ware Deluxe Kettle Smoker includes a smoker base, domed lid with adjustable vents, and five woodchip varieties. This in-store-only deal at Costco is priced at $19.97, though availability may vary by location.

item.title: Yukon Glory Portable Grill Table with Caddy for $69.99
item.description: This portable grill table from Yukon Glory is designed to hold flat top griddles and grills, featuring a built-in caddy for utensils and accessories. The deal price is $69.99 with free shipping for Prime members.

item.title: Samvinor 700W HVLP Paint Sprayer with 2 Nozzles for $21.49
item.description: The Samvinor 700W HVLP handheld electric paint sprayer includes two nozzles and three spray patterns. It is available for $21.49 after a 50% discount with promo code SU2V0Y2V, originally priced at $42.99.

item.title: Master Cook Charcoal Grill for $83.29 with free shipping
item.description: This charcoal grill is designed for outdoor barbecuing. The deal brings it to $83.29 with free shipping for Prime members.

item.title: Coliware Portable Charcoal Grill with Accessories for $47.99 at Walmart
item.description: The Coliware Portable Outdoor Tabletop Charcoal Grill comes with accessories and is currently available for $47.99 at Walmart. Shipping is free for this item, which is fulfilled by Walmart.
